post.description:
Ask the synthesis model to propose missing alignment links with strengths. Sends element texts (outcome
statements, assessment titles, topic names) of this draft version to the `synthesize` route's provider.

Map every outcome, assessment and topic (all courses, or the given ones): the synthesis model proposes each
element's connections with a level (direct / strong / partial), or reports that it found none. Proposals are
written to this draft as dashed "AI?" links; nothing becomes documented. Sends element texts to the provider.

schema.title: Response List Outline Imports Api V1 Versions  Version Id  Courses  Course Id  Outline Imports Get

post.description:
Import a course outline for this course: a PDF, DOCX or text file, pasted text, or a document already
uploaded. The job reads it, extracts its outcomes, assessments and topics (route `extract`), and asks the
reconcile agent (route `synthesize`) what the program needs from it. The outline text and this course's
elements are sent to those routes' providers. Nothing changes until a plan is applied.
